statement.zh: 学术与博物馆综合将大神庙表述为特诺奇蒂特兰墨西卡三重同盟都城的核心仪礼建筑（Matos Moctezuma 发掘传统；Smith 2012）。
statement.en: Scholarly and museum syntheses frame the Templo Mayor as the central ceremonial architecture of Mexica Triple Alliance Tenochtitlan (Matos Moctezuma excavation tradition; Smith 2012).
